caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate table with a dark, likely black or very deep brown, rectangular tabletop that has curved edges and a slightly marbled appearance. The table is supported by four elaborately carved legs, which are decorated with swirling, leaf-like motifs and scrollwork in a reddish-brown wood tone, suggesting a rich wooden material. The legs curve outward and end in delicate scroll shapes at the feet. Additional elaborate carvings connect the legs along the sides and front, including a prominent symmetrical motif in the center of the front, which incorporates organic and floral elements. The table is set against a plain, light beige background within a thin, dark rectangular border. There is no other object present in the composition, and the artist’s signature “JNO. GARAY” appears in small writing beneath the lower right corner of the table.
title: Pier Table
